pi -p --mode json --provider dashscope --model qwen3.7-plus --no-session Create ini.py with a function parse(text) that parses INI text and returns a dict mapping section names to dicts of key/value pairs. Rules: sections are `[name]` lines; keys are `key = value` (spaces around `=` optional); lines starting with `#` or `;` are comments, and a ` ;` or ` #` (space then the character) after a value or after a section header starts a trailing comment that is ignored; blank lines are ignored; values may be double- or single-quoted, in which case the quotes are stripped and everything inside is kept verbatim (including spaces and `#`/`;`); unquoted values `true`/`false` in any case become booleans and unquoted values that are valid integers (optional sign, digits) become ints, everything else stays a string; a repeated key keeps the last value; a repeated section merges into the earlier one; keys before any section header go into a section named `DEFAULT`; a line that is not a comment, section or key=value raises ValueError, as does a section header without the closing bracket. Empty input returns {}.

pi -p --mode json --provider dashscope --model qwen3.7-plus --no-session Rename the function LoadConfig to ReadConfig everywhere in this repository: code, tests, documentation, the Makefile comment and the shell script's usage text. Only count lines with status 200. Print nothing else. Verify it on access.log before finishing.
